patch_description: Crossover of the greedy placement (current best) with the local-search refinement. The previous local search failed with "list.remove(x): x not in list" because test cases contain duplicate/equal model objects. Fix: perform moves and swaps by index rather than object identity, track placement as (model, index) pairs so removal is unambiguous, and guard against infinite loops. Keep the greedy assignment as initialization, then apply move and swap neighborhoods with a max-iteration cap. This preserves feasibility (memory checks) while lowering the max KVPR.
